name: Roman Forns
headline: Data Architect & BI Consultant
summary: Data Architect and engineer with 13 years of professional experience, 8+ of them in data and BI, across retail, chemicals, energy, transport and maritime. Leads end-to-end data architecture, BI ecosystems, cloud data pipelines (GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric) and enterprise integration (SAP–Salesforce, event-driven). As PM-Tech Lead, takes engagements from discovery with the client to production. Outside client work, builds products from scratch on a self-hosted lab, using AI coding agents day to day.
summaryExtended: Data Architect and engineer with 13 years of professional experience, 8+ in data and BI (retail, chemicals, energy, transport, maritime). BI and data warehousing, cloud pipelines (GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Fabric), enterprise integration (SAP–Salesforce, event-driven), ETL and orchestration (Talend, dbt, Airflow), Python and FastAPI services. PM-Tech Lead and solution architect on multi-year engagements; builds reusable frameworks and scalable data platforms. Applies AI to governed reporting and to everyday engineering work.

experience.title: Data Architect & BI Consultant
experience.summary: End-to-end data architecture, integration and orchestration for enterprise clients in retail, chemicals, energy and transport. PM-Tech Lead on recent engagements (DOMO, Ciments Molins, DACSA, GAM Family, OCA Global), owning delivery from discovery to production.
impact: Established best practices for event-driven architectures and data orchestration across heterogeneous systems.
Delivered cloud-native pipelines (GCP, Azure, Snowflake, Fabric), enabling scalable analytics and near real-time reporting.
Technical lead on delivery and business development: As-Is assessments and Board-ready proposals on Fabric and GCP, plus architectural blueprints and reusable frameworks.

projects.summary: Deployment of the Microsoft Fabric infrastructure and migration of the data architecture alongside Dynamics 365: medallion layers, a dbt project (60+ Silver models and Gold dimensions), and PySpark ingestion notebooks for Eurostat, AEMET and CBOT.
projects.outcome: Fabric infrastructure and the migrated architecture in production, with customer, financial and product data, and CI/CD for dbt and SQL Warehouses.

proposal.label: Commercial proposal
proposal.summary: Board-ready proposal for an operational integration backbone on the Fabric platform deployed in 2026: an operational canonical model, an event engine, an Operational Data Hub, edge and transaction planes, Dynamics readiness, and a governed path to agents.
proposal.outcome: A stop-and-go programme that reuses the analytical canon already in production instead of rebuilding it.

projects.summary: Financial planning and analysis for the group's finance arm, about 40 companies. Minerva loads Excel templates and masters from SharePoint, orchestrates ingestion in Azure Data Factory, transforms them through a Databricks medallion, and refreshes Power BI.
projects.outcome: Business users run PROCESS, REPROCESS or DELETE by company, year, month and concept from a Canvas App, with Power Automate calling the pipelines.

projects.summary: Customer master integration between Salesforce and the Data Hub (ODH/SAP): a canonical JSON model and a custom Java JSON utility library (2,500+ lines) driving Talend read, write, backfill and CDC.
projects.outcome: Traceable bidirectional sync across Data Hub, CRM and ERP, using structural comparison to choose POST or PATCH.

projects.summary: Migration of the GPC_Tous data platform from a monolithic base (Flask, coupled DAGs, scattered config) to a layered one: FastAPI APIs for recommendations, abandoned cart and wishlist, a repository pattern with multi-level cache, and metadata-driven Airflow DAGs defined in YAML.
projects.outcome: 27+ pipelines moved onto the layered platform with the same behaviour, lower API latency, shorter DAG runtime and lower BigQuery and Dataflow cost.

projects.summary: Analysis of the FyM Inmovilizado Power BI semantic model on Snowflake (hundreds of tables, 150+ relationships), covering modelling and DAX under high volumetry.
projects.outcome: Ten modelling and DAX anti-patterns documented, with a prioritised optimisation plan and a phased roadmap.

projects.summary: BI and data for sustainability and commercial: corporate sustainability dashboards, a central SSAS Tabular model (Join Life, rankings, composition), a Snowflake data layer, and Power BI reporting for SSP and GTW traceability, with RLS and data governance.
projects.outcome: One analytical model and operational reports, with legacy DB2 and Oracle sources migrated to Snowflake under validation.

projects.summary: As-Is assessment of a Power BI and Fabric PPU estate (44 workspaces, 514 artefacts) with no medallion layer, and a To-Be proposal to migrate toward the same DDP-DataOS pattern used at DACSA.
projects.outcome: An evidence-based baseline of usage, gateways, ownership and debt used to justify the DataOS migration. The medallion platform is proposed, not deployed.

projects.summary: Delivery design for governed AI reporting on the existing Financial DWH in BigQuery: a semantic layer and Dataplex catalog, SELECT-only text-to-SQL agents, versioned report generation, and a portal that serves dashboards without an AI cost per view.
projects.outcome: A four-block plan from discovery to go-live that replaces uncontrolled GenAI self-service with a platform controlled by IT. Design and estimate, not a completed go-live.

personalProjects.title: MDIF — Metadata-Driven Ingestion Framework
personalProjects.description: Python framework for automated migration and ingestion across PostgreSQL, MySQL and Snowflake. Declarative YAML config, schema discovery from INFORMATION_SCHEMA, idempotent DDL with type mapping, and batch or cursor-based incremental loads orchestrated in Airflow, with post-ingestion row-count checks. Deployed with Docker Compose.
personalProjects.outcome: A single config drives discovery, DDL and load, and re-runs stay idempotent.

personalProjects.title: Winery platform
personalProjects.description: Operations platform for a winery, from the vineyard and the cellar to the bottled lot, stock, invoicing and sales. A staff portal and a Telegram agent work on the same backend, and an order is created only after a person confirms it. Each lot keeps its genealogy. Delivery, invoice and payment are separate steps, so a sale is recorded before the wine has left and before it has been paid. A commercial website and a broker variant are built and not yet launched. Its operational data feeds the lab's data platform.
personalProjects.outcome: Every operation stays traceable from the grape through vinification to the bottled lot.

personalProjects.title: Boat Assistant
personalProjects.description: Software for a connected boat. Sensor, weather and alarm data reach a local helm that the skipper can use with no internet. The lab boat speaks the same protocol as the onboard hardware, so what is tested in the lab is what goes on board. Model suggestions stay advisory: critical alarms are raised by rules running on the boat itself.
personalProjects.outcome: A skipper can run the boat from a local helm, and each trip's history is ready for the shared data platform.

personalProjects.title: Home lab — platform, data and agents
personalProjects.description: Self-hosted environment where the products above are built and proved. Proxmox VE with ZFS and LXC, with remote access, name resolution and the public entry run in-house. A deployment gateway publishes a proven workload first to a three-node Kubernetes cluster and then to a commercial provider. A shared data platform (change capture, immutable history, current state and prepared views) keeps each application's data isolated, with DataHub holding lineage and the catalog per application and tenant. The lab is operated with AI agents: OpenCode for node operations, Cursor for product development. Next: an ML training area (no model trained yet) and an ESP32-S3 electronics bench for telemetry and streaming.
personalProjects.outcome: Every product is tested on the same infrastructure path before it is published to a commercial provider.
